svg.title: Qara-Chik Demarcation Line
svg.desc: The ceasefire line between the ISEZ and the Autonomous Tribal Regions as it has run since the 2009 protocol on the Toktogul basin and the State Route 1 corridor, with its four UNMI sectors, the 12 km restricted-weapons zone, the main crossing and UN headquarters. Line, zones and restricted zone: Kartalar map data. Base map: Natural Earth (public domain).
